AI.title_zh: 面向受控世界模型自适应的校准风险路由
AI.abstract_zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）可以利用模拟经验，但从模拟器到目标域的偏移会产生一个模型选择问题：在目标数据有限的情况下，修正模拟器和直接拟合目标这两者都可能失败。我们提出模型校正世界模型（Model-Corrected World Model, MC-WM），它将初始目标数据划分为互不相交的拟合、选择和校准分区，并部署标准化校准风险较低的那一模型族。一个学习得到的置信信号与确定性有效性谓词对单步想象策略更新进行加权，而不改写物理奖励。我们在三个受控的带接触多关节动力学（Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact, MuJoCo）偏移上评估了540个唯一的已报告运行单元；在部署前伪影门控之后，一个精确路由单元被重复执行，最终得到541次完成的执行。

title: Variational Streaming Flow: Probabilistic Forecasting in Physical Time
summary: Probabilistic forecasting is important for predicting complex dynamical systems because intrinsic randomness and incomplete observations can cause the same observed state to evolve into multiple plausible futures. While flow matching is a flexible approach for probabilistic forecasting, it is computationally expensive. Streaming flow (SF) reformulates this approach to model temporal evolution efficiently by learning a continuous velocity field directly in physical time. However, SF learns a deterministic velocity field. Thus, it provides only a single future trajectory for a given fixed initial state and observation history. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Variational Streaming Flow (VSF). Our approach learns a latent distribution that is conditioned on the dynamics of interest. In turn, this enables probabilistic forecasting. Importantly, we retain the computational efficiency of SF by generating in physical time. Across deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems, VSF demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and distributional fidelity. We demonstrate the advantage for both long-horizon rollouts exceeding 1,000 steps, and settings with bifurcating dynamics. Moreover, VSF can be integrated into existing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-based world models as a plug-and-play predictor to improve temporal dynamics and goal-directed success rate in navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.

AI.title_zh: 变分流式流：物理时间中的概率预测
AI.abstract_zh: 概率预测对于预测复杂动力系统十分重要，因为内在随机性和不完整观测可能导致相同的观测状态演化出多种可能的未来。尽管流匹配（flow matching）是一种灵活的概率预测方法，但其计算代价高昂。流式流（Streaming Flow, SF）通过直接在物理时间中学习连续速度场，对该方法进行了重新表述，从而高效地建模时间演化。然而，SF 学习的是确定性速度场。因此，对于给定的固定初始状态和观测历史，它只能提供单一的未来轨迹。为克服这一局限，我们提出了变分流式流（Variational Streaming Flow, VSF）。我们的方法学习一个以所关注的动力学为条件的潜变量分布。这进而使得概率预测成为可能。重要的是，我们通过在物理时间中生成，保留了 SF 的计算效率。在确定性动力系统和随机动力系统中，VSF 均展现出更优的预测准确性和分布保真度。我们展示了其在超过 1,000 步的长时程推演以及具有分岔动力学的设定中的优势。此外，VSF 可作为即插即用的预测器集成到现有的基于联合嵌入预测架构（Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture, JEPA）的世界模型中，以改进时间动力学以及在导航、运动规划和操作中的目标导向成功率。

title: In CEM, a World Model Is Also a Proposal Mechanism
summary: The cross-entropy method (CEM) uses world-model scores to select action sequences and fit the distribution sampled in its next iteration. A scoring error can therefore change both the present decision and the candidates considered later. We evaluate these two roles separately. Four types of predictive model generate CEM traces, and every model rescores every saved candidate pool. Executing the same candidates in the environment provides a reference elite set and proposal update. Across twelve independently trained task-seed units on Walker and Cheetah, the pre-specified proposal distance falls from the first to the final CEM iteration in every unit. Proposal widths contract and fitted means separate relative to the remaining search width. Pairwise ranking agreement stays near chance on Walker and declines on Cheetah; elite-set agreement does not improve. This comparison shows greater variation between scorers than between pool sources on Cheetah; Walker has variation in both and in their pairings. We use the original six units to select Random nonlinear for a one-update intervention, without inspecting intervention outcomes. Replacing its first model-ranked update with an environment-ranked update lowers final realised selected-sequence cost in those six units and in six further units held out from the selection.

AI.title_zh: 在 CEM 中，世界模型也是一种提议机制
AI.abstract_zh: 交叉熵方法（cross-entropy method, CEM）使用世界模型得分来选择动作序列，并拟合其下一次迭代中所采样的分布。因此，一个评分误差既可能改变当前的决策，也可能改变之后所考虑的候选。我们分别评估这两种角色。四类预测模型生成 CEM 轨迹，并且每个模型都会对每个保存的候选池重新评分。在环境中执行相同的候选可提供一个参考精英集（elite set）和提议更新。在 Walker 和 Cheetah 上十二个独立训练的任务-种子单元中，预先指定的提议距离在每个单元中都从第一次 CEM 迭代到最终 CEM 迭代下降。提议宽度收缩，并且拟合均值相对于剩余搜索宽度发生分离。成对排名一致性在 Walker 上接近随机水平，在 Cheetah 上下降；精英集一致性没有改善。这一比较显示，在 Cheetah 上，评分器之间的差异大于池来源之间的差异；Walker 在两者及其配对中都有差异。我们使用最初的六个单元选择 Random nonlinear 进行一次更新干预，且不检查干预结果。将其第一次按模型排名的更新替换为按环境排名的更新，会降低这六个单元以及从选择中留出的另外六个单元中最终实现的选择序列成本。

title: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
summary: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) combine scene estimation, interaction grounding, and executable actions. Understanding how these abilities support complete robotic tasks is central to evaluating their readiness as robot generalists. We introduce Embodied Agent Arena to examine where local competence supports, or falls short of, complete task success across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. The arena contains 1,000 cases drawn from 32 established sources and GeoProbe, our new benchmark for geometric estimation on Blender renders and real-scene images. A minimal harness preserves source observations and operations while separating metric precision, functional grounding, and native goal completion. We evaluate seven VLMs, analyze Astra's task-specific advantages, and compare richer-observation execution protocols and multi-round review. Across the arena, Astra's advantage is strongest in precise estimation and usable-contact localization; completing coordinated, goal-directed actions remains the key gap to robot generalism.

AI.title_zh: 前沿 VLM 智能体是否已准备好成为机器人通才？基于具身智能体竞技场的实证研究
AI.abstract_zh: 前沿视觉语言模型（VLM）融合了场景估计、交互 grounding 与可执行动作。理解这些能力如何支撑完整的机器人任务，是评估其作为机器人通才（robot generalist）就绪程度的核心。我们提出具身智能体竞技场（Embodied Agent Arena），以考察在几何、空间推理、可供性（affordance）、任务规划与操作这五个方面，局部能力在何处支撑了完整任务的成功、又在何处未能达到。该竞技场包含 1,000 个案例，取自 32 个既有来源以及 GeoProbe——我们为 Blender 渲染图与真实场景图像上的几何估计所建立的新基准。一个最小化的测试框架保留了源观测与操作，同时将度量精度、功能 grounding 与原生目标完成区分开来。我们评估了七个 VLM，分析了 Astra 在特定任务上的优势，并比较了更丰富观测的执行协议与多轮复核。在整个竞技场中，Astra 的优势在精确估计与可用接触定位方面最为突出；完成协调的、目标导向的动作仍是通往机器人通才性的关键差距。

title: Kepler: Auditable World Models for ARC-AGI-3
comment: 17 pages. Accepted to the non-archival Interpreting Agent Behavior workshop at NeurIPS 2026. Project: https://kepler-harness.vercel.app/ . Code and public traces available
summary: ARC-AGI-3 evaluates agents in interactive environments whose rules and objectives must be inferred from observation. We present Kepler, an open-source harness that represents hypotheses as executable world models and validates them through retrospective transition checks and conditional prediction checks. Under one frozen Claude Opus 5 configuration, Kepler obtained a server-verified 100.00 RHAE on all 25 public games, with no per-game model selection or score-conditioned reruns. On 181 of 183 completed levels, the final Opus attempt used no more actions than the corresponding median-human baseline. The retained board runs used 8,256 environment actions, of which 7,292 occurred in scored levels. Retained local provider-session records yield 858.0 million tokens, 97.37% cache reads, and a \$777.72 cost at September 1, 2026 API list-equivalent rates. We also report three evaluation failures: source-code leakage that produced an invalid perfect run, agents reconstructing a removed harness in a control condition, and autonomous repair masking a broken planner. A single-game observation case study showed that animation frames contained task-relevant information absent from settled text grids. Across the final Claude Opus 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol boards, 48 of 50 game-model cells reached 100. These results indicate that public-set score alone has limited discriminative value and motivate first-attempt, cost-conditioned, and verification-aware reporting.

AI.title_zh: Kepler：面向 ARC-AGI-3 的可审计世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: ARC-AGI-3 在规则与目标必须从观察中推断的交互式环境中评估智能体。我们提出 Kepler，一个开源测试框架（harness），它将假设表示为可执行世界模型，并通过回溯式转移检查与条件预测检查对其进行验证。在一个固定的 Claude Opus 5 配置下，Kepler 在所有 25 个公开游戏上获得了服务器验证的 100.00 RHAE，且没有按游戏进行模型选择，也没有依据分数进行重跑。在 183 个已完成关卡中的 181 个上，Opus 的最后一次尝试所用的动作数不多于相应的人类中位数基线。保留的棋盘运行共使用 8,256 次环境动作，其中 7,292 次发生在计分关卡中。保留的本地提供商会话记录产生 858.0 百万 token、97.37% 缓存读取，以及按 2026 年 9 月 1 日 API 标价等价费率计算的 \$777.72 成本。我们还报告了三类评估失败：源代码泄露导致了无效的完美运行；智能体在对照条件下重建了被移除的测试框架；以及自主修复掩盖了一个损坏的规划器。一项单游戏观察案例研究表明，动画帧包含已稳定文本网格中缺失的任务相关信息。在最终的 Claude Opus 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 棋盘上，50 个游戏-模型单元中有 48 个达到 100。这些结果表明，仅凭公开集分数其区分价值有限，并促使采用首次尝试、成本条件化以及验证感知的报告方式。

title: Video Generation Models: A Survey of Post-Training and Alignment
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2026. Project page: https://github.com/people-robots/Awesome-Video-Generation-Post-Training
summary: Video generation has rapidly progressed from short, low-quality clips to high-resolution, long-duration sequences with complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Despite strong generative priors learned through large-scale pretraining, pretrained video models often fail to reliably follow human intent, maintain temporal coherence, or satisfy physical and safety constraints. Compared with image and text generation, alignment in video generation presents unique challenges, including error accumulation over time, motion-appearance coupling, multi-objective trade-offs, and limited supervision for temporal properties. These challenges motivate systematic post-training strategies that adapt pretrained models without retraining them from scratch. In this survey, we present the first comprehensive review of post-training and alignment in video generation models. We frame post-training as a unifying framework and distinguish between implicit alignment and explicit alignment based on how alignment signals are enforced. From this perspective, we organize existing approaches into four broad categories: supervised fine-tuning methods, self-training and distillation methods, preference- and reward-based methods, and inference-time methods. This taxonomy provides a coherent view of how alignment signals shape model behavior across both training and deployment. Beyond methodological advances, we review commonly used datasets, benchmarks, and evaluation practices, and discuss open challenges such as scalable reward design, long-horizon temporal consistency, stability-expressiveness trade-offs, and safety-aware generation. This survey aims to provide a structured conceptual foundation and practical guidance for advancing controllable and reliable video generation models.

AI.title_zh: 视频生成模型：后训练与对齐综述
AI.abstract_zh: 视频生成已从短时长、低质量的片段迅速发展为具有复杂时空动态的高分辨率、长时长序列。尽管通过大规模预训练学到了强大的生成先验，预训练视频模型往往仍难以可靠地遵循人类意图、保持时间连贯性，或满足物理与安全约束。与图像和文本生成相比，视频生成中的对齐呈现出独特挑战，包括随时间的误差累积、运动—外观耦合、多目标权衡，以及针对时间属性的监督有限。这些挑战促使人们采用系统化的后训练策略，在不从头重新训练的情况下对预训练模型进行适配。在本综述中，我们给出了关于视频生成模型后训练与对齐的首个全面回顾。我们将后训练构建为一个统一框架，并根据对齐信号施加方式的不同，区分隐式对齐与显式对齐。基于这一视角，我们将现有方法组织为四大类：监督微调方法、自训练与蒸馏方法、基于偏好与奖励的方法，以及推理时方法。这一分类法为理解对齐信号如何在训练与部署过程中塑造模型行为提供了一致视角。除方法学进展外，我们还回顾了常用数据集、基准与评估实践，并讨论了诸如可扩展奖励设计、长时程时间一致性、稳定性—表现力权衡以及安全感知生成等开放性挑战。本综述旨在为推进可控且可靠的视频生成模型提供结构化的概念基础与实践指导。

title: CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization
summary: Controlling an agent with vision requires being able to separate useful information from irrelevant background information. JEPA-style latent world models seem like a natural approach for this, as they do not perform pixel-level reconstruction; however, they are still sensitive to these distractor signals and experience latent collapse. In this work, we introduce Controllability Factorized JEPA (CF-JEPA), a JEPA-style world model which splits the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. This factorization allows us to capture all the distractor information into the uncontrollable region, while we use the control-relevant latent information for our task. With this, we show comparable performance across 2D and 3D control tasks under nominal conditions and improved performance under distracted conditions, where CF-JEPA is the only model that does not experience latent collapse. We also validate our model under distracted conditions for a simulated robot task, highlighting the practical application of such a scheme.

AI.title_zh: CF-JEPA：通过可控性因子分解提升JEPA世界模型的鲁棒性
AI.abstract_zh: 使用视觉控制智能体需要能够将有用信息与无关的背景信息分离开来。JEPA风格（JEPA-style）的潜在世界模型似乎是应对这一问题的自然方法，因为它们不进行像素级重建；然而，它们仍然对这些干扰信号敏感，并会经历潜在坍缩（latent collapse）。在这项工作中，我们引入了可控性因子分解JEPA（Controllability Factorized JEPA，CF-JEPA），这是一种JEPA风格的世界模型，它将潜在空间划分为可控子空间和不可控子空间。这种因子分解使我们能够将所有干扰信息捕获到不可控区域中，同时我们将与控制相关的潜在信息用于我们的任务。借此，我们展示了在标称条件下跨2D和3D控制任务上相当的性能，以及在受干扰条件下更优的性能，其中CF-JEPA是唯一没有经历潜在坍缩的模型。我们还在模拟机器人任务的受干扰条件下验证了我们的模型，突出了此类方案的实用应用。

title: JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts
comment: Accepted to World Models in Physical AI Workshop @ NeurIPS 2026 | Project page: https://jepa-ttt.github.io/
summary: World models enable agents to plan by predicting future states of the environment, but their predictions can become unreliable when test-time dynamics differ from those seen during training. We present JEPA-TTT, which adapts the latent dynamics predictor of a pretrained action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture world model throughout test time. Self-supervised updates accumulate across episodes, while the visual encoder and reward head remain fixed, preserving the pretrained representation and task objective. Planning requires neither a goal image nor online environment reward. JEPA-TTT uses dense replay, which forms prediction windows at every temporal offset, retains them in a growing buffer, and samples minibatches from that buffer for predictor updates. Across eight dynamics shifts in four continuous-control environments, JEPA-TTT improves planning on every shift. After 500 test-time episodes, it reduces autoregressive latent prediction error by 83% on average and improves planning performance by 153% over the frozen JEPA world model. These results show that persistent self-supervised test-time training can adapt a pretrained latent world model under changed dynamics.

AI.title_zh: JEPA-TTT：面向动力学变化下规划的潜在世界模型的持续测试时训练
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型使智能体能够通过预测环境的未来状态来进行规划，但当测试时的动力学与训练时所见的动力学不同时，其预测可能变得不可靠。我们提出 JEPA-TTT，它在整个测试期间对预训练的动作条件联合嵌入预测架构（Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture）世界模型的潜在动力学预测器进行适应。自监督更新跨回合累积，而视觉编码器和奖励头保持固定，从而保留预训练的表示和任务目标。规划既不需要目标图像，也不需要在线环境奖励。JEPA-TTT 使用密集回放（dense replay），即在每个时间偏移处形成预测窗口，将其保留在不断增长的缓冲区中，并从该缓冲区采样小批量以更新预测器。在四个连续控制环境中的八种动力学变化下，JEPA-TTT 在每一种变化上都改善了规划。经过 500 个测试时回合后，它将自回归潜在预测误差平均降低 83%，并将规划性能相较于冻结的 JEPA 世界模型提升 153%。这些结果表明，持续的自监督测试时训练能够在动力学发生变化的情况下使预训练的潜在世界模型得到适应。

title: Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio
summary: Recent joint audio-video generative models can synthesize realistic videos with synchronized sound, but typically generate audio as a single mixed track. This limits source-level control and differs from practical audiovisual workflows, where speech, music, sound effects, and ambient sounds are represented as separate editable tracks. We introduce Soundwich, a training-free framework that transforms a frozen joint audio-video flow-matching model into a generator of multiple synchronized, independently editable audio stems coupled to a shared video. Soundwich generates separate audio stems with explicit control over their temporal activity. To keep separately generated sounds coherent, we introduce a shared scene representation that communicates global audiovisual context across stems while preserving their source-level separation. We further route cross-modal interactions between each audio stem and its corresponding visual source, improving audiovisual consistency. The resulting stems remain synchronized with the video and can be independently retimed, muted, replaced, or remixed. Experiments and human evaluations show improved temporal control, source separation, and naturalness, while enabling flexible source-level editing within coherent audiovisual generation. Code is available at https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich.

AI.title_zh: Soundwich：具有分层且可控音频的视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 近期的音视频联合生成模型能够合成带有同步声音的逼真视频，但通常将音频生成为单一混合音轨。这限制了源级别的控制，并且与实际视听工作流程不同——在实际流程中，语音、音乐、音效和环境声被表示为各自独立、可编辑的音轨。我们提出 Soundwich，一个免训练（training-free）框架，它将一个冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型转变为与共享视频耦合的多个同步、可独立编辑音频分轨（audio stems）的生成器。Soundwich 生成分离的音频分轨，并可对其时间活动进行显式控制。为保持分别生成的声音之间的连贯性，我们引入一种共享场景表示，它在各分轨之间传递全局视听上下文，同时保持其源级别的分离。我们进一步为每个音频分轨与其对应的视觉源之间建立跨模态交互路径，从而提升视听一致性。所得到的分轨与视频保持同步，并可被独立地重新定时、静音、替换或重新混音。实验与人工评估表明，该方法在时间控制、源分离和自然度方面有所提升，同时能够在连贯的音视频生成中实现灵活的源级别编辑。代码可在 https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich 获取。

title: SemanTok: Predictable Semantic Tokens for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
comment: 29 pages, 22 figures, including references and appendix; 9 pages of main text
summary: Recent video-based world models pair the scalability of autoregressive (AR) prediction with the visual quality of diffusion models. The choice of scene tokenizer is paramount for the optimal performance of each of these, both in terms of fidelity and semantics. Flexible-length, coarse-to-fine tokenizers yield exactly that: the first coarse tokens carry the clip's global semantics while later tokens further specify details. Existing flexible tokenizers only apply a representation-alignment (REPA) loss on early decoder hidden states, a target the decoder can partly meet from its noised input instead. We introduce SemanTok, a flexible video tokenizer that feeds frozen DINO features into its encoder and adds lightweight heads that reconstruct them from each retained token prefix alone. SemanTok achieves high semantic alignment and video fidelity at every AR model size: a 201M SemanTok AR model matches or beats a VideoFlexTok AR model $3.4\times$ its size, and larger SemanTok AR models further improve fidelity. It keeps semantic alignment on out-of-distribution classes and gives the decoder higher semantic alignment at every noise level, including pure noise. It performs well in both reconstruction and generation, and its short token prefixes are cheaper to predict and give better generation fidelity, with pixel detail deferred to later tokens.

AI.title_zh: SemanTok：用于高效自回归视频生成的可预测语义令牌
AI.abstract_zh: 近期基于视频的世界模型将自回归（AR）预测的可扩展性与扩散模型的视觉质量结合起来。场景分词器（tokenizer）的选择对于二者的最优性能都至关重要，无论是在保真度还是语义方面。可变长度、由粗到细的分词器恰好能实现这一点：最初的粗粒度令牌携带片段的全局语义，而后续令牌则进一步明确细节。现有的可变分词器仅在早期解码器隐藏状态上施加表示对齐（REPA）损失，而解码器可以部分地仅凭其带噪输入就满足这一目标。我们提出 SemanTok，一种可变视频分词器，它将冻结的 DINO 特征输入其编码器，并添加轻量级头，仅从每个保留的令牌前缀中重建这些特征。SemanTok 在每种 AR 模型规模下都实现了高语义对齐和视频保真度：一个 201M 的 SemanTok AR 模型可匹配或超越规模为其 $3.4\times$ 的 VideoFlexTok AR 模型，而更大的 SemanTok AR 模型则进一步提升保真度。它在分布外类别上仍保持语义对齐，并在每个噪声水平（包括纯噪声）下为解码器提供更高的语义对齐。它在重建和生成方面均表现良好，且其较短的令牌前缀预测成本更低、生成保真度更好，像素细节则推迟到后续令牌中。

title: TacDyn-WAM: Learning Implicit Tactile Dynamics in a Heterogeneous Visuo-Tactile World Action Model
summary: World action models improve robotic manipulation by conditioning actions on predicted futures, yet existing tactile variants largely inherit video-generation pipelines that reconstruct future tactile observations through iterative denoising. Such prediction can become unreliable under deployment drift: small changes in contact position or force may substantially alter tactile pixels even when the underlying contact evolution remains predictable. We introduce TacDyn-WAM, a heterogeneous visuo-tactile world action model that predicts implicit tactile dynamics rather than reconstructing future tactile observations. It learns TacRep, a dynamics-aware tactile target space trained through masked spatio-temporal prediction on tactile clips and regularized by relational structure distillation. A visual expert and an Implicit Tactile Dynamics Expert predict future visual and tactile representations in separate target spaces while interacting through joint attention; the tactile expert predicts future representations and their changes at multiple horizons in a single forward pass, and a read-only tactile memory supplies the current tactile state. On UniVTAC, TacDyn-WAM achieves an average success rate of 81.5% using only the provided demonstrations, reaching state-of-the-art-level performance and remaining competitive with models pretrained on large-scale visuo-tactile trajectories. Ablations confirm the benefits of both tactile pathways and TacRep over pixel-reconstruction and static alternatives. On five real-robot tasks, TacDyn-WAM reaches 71.0% average success, and modest-scale pretraining raises it to 85.0%, further validating our method.

AI.title_zh: TacDyn-WAM：在异构视触世界动作模型中学习隐式触觉动力学
AI.abstract_zh: 世界动作模型通过以预测的未来为条件来改进机器人操作，然而现有的触觉变体大多继承了视频生成流程，即通过迭代去噪来重建未来的触觉观测。这种预测在部署漂移下可能变得不可靠：即使潜在的接触演化仍然可预测，接触位置或力的微小变化也可能大幅改变触觉像素。我们提出 TacDyn-WAM，一种异构视触世界动作模型，它预测隐式触觉动力学，而非重建未来的触觉观测。它学习 TacRep，一个动力学感知的触觉目标空间，通过在触觉片段上进行掩蔽时空预测来训练，并由关系结构蒸馏进行正则化。一个视觉专家和一个隐式触觉动力学专家在各自独立的目标空间中预测未来的视觉与触觉表征，同时通过联合注意力进行交互；触觉专家在单次前向传播中预测多个时间跨度上的未来表征及其变化，而一个只读的触觉记忆提供当前触觉状态。在 UniVTAC 上，TacDyn-WAM 仅使用所提供的示范数据即达到 81.5% 的平均成功率，达到最先进水平的表现，并与在大规模视触轨迹上预训练的模型相比仍具竞争力。消融实验证实了两条触觉通路以及 TacRep 相对于像素重建和静态替代方案的收益。在五个真实机器人任务上，TacDyn-WAM 达到 71.0% 的平均成功率，而中等规模预训练将其提升至 85.0%，进一步验证了我们的方法。

title: Token-World: World Modeling in Vision-Language Model Token Space for Robot Manipulation
comment: Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA) 2027
summary: A common approach to world-model simulation for vision-language-action (VLA) systems is to predict future RGB observations and then re-encode them into policy inputs, introducing an indirect interface between simulation and downstream policy execution. We instead investigate whether world dynamics can be modeled in a compact, policy-oriented state derived from VLM visual tokens. A key challenge is that raw VLM visual tokens are high-dimensional, making efficient and accurate autoregressive dynamics modeling challenging. To address this, we introduce Token-World, an action-conditioned world model that compresses VLM features into a compact token state, learns future dynamics in this reduced space, and maps predicted states back to the original policy-facing representation for downstream use. Across manipulation benchmarks, Token-World improves open-loop feature fidelity and policy-action consistency over recent world-model simulators, with slower degradation over long rollout horizons. In closed-loop evaluation, its simulated policy performance correlates more strongly with reference policy performance than Ctrl-World ($r=0.794$ vs.\ $0.583$), while requiring lower simulation latency. Ablations further show that compact-representation design and dimensionality substantially affect future-state prediction. Code will be available at https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/.

AI.title_zh: Token-World：面向机器人操作的视觉语言模型Token空间中的世界建模
AI.abstract_zh: 面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统的世界模型仿真的一种常见做法是预测未来的RGB观测，再将其重新编码为策略输入，从而在仿真与下游策略执行之间引入了一个间接接口。我们转而研究是否可以在源自VLM视觉token的紧凑、面向策略的状态中建模世界动态。一个关键挑战在于，原始VLM视觉token是高维的，这使得高效且准确的自回归动态建模颇具挑战性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Token-World，一种动作条件世界模型，它将VLM特征压缩为紧凑的token状态，在这一降维空间中学习未来动态，并将预测状态映射回原本面向策略的表示以供下游使用。在多个操作基准上，Token-World在开环特征保真度和策略-动作一致性方面优于近期的世界模型仿真器，并且在长时域展开中退化更慢。在闭环评估中，其仿真策略性能与参考策略性能的相关性强于Ctrl-World（$r=0.794$ 对比 $0.583$），同时所需的仿真延迟更低。消融实验进一步表明，紧凑表示的设计与维度会显著影响未来状态预测。代码将在 https://chuyaofu.github.io/Token-World/ 提供。

title: PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal reasoning capabilities, yet whether they truly capture the physical consistency underlying real-world dynamics remains unclear. Existing benchmark paradigms often suffer from fragmented evaluation, focusing on isolated cognitive stages while overlooking the inherent synergy between perception, reasoning, and physical judgment. The lack of a holistic perspective limits the ability to diagnose whether VLMs can reliably evaluate the physical authenticity of emerging generative models. To address these issues, we introduce PhysVista, a benchmark designed to evaluate physical intelligence in VLMs through a closed cognitive loop framework inspired by the human seeing-reasoning-assessment process. PhysVista restores this loop by jointly evaluating physical state perception, physical dynamics reasoning, and physical plausibility assessment. It further distinguishes event-level reasoning and scale-level reasoning to enable fine-grained analysis of physical understanding. In addition, PhysVista incorporates both real-world and AI-generated videos, allowing evaluation across diverse domains and emerging generative scenarios. Extensive experiments across a diverse set of VLMs reveal substantial limitations in physical reasoning and plausibility assessment, highlighting a persistent gap between visual recognition and genuine physical understanding, and pointing toward more principled designs for physically grounded multimodal intelligence.

AI.title_zh: PhysVista：通过感知-推理-评估闭环对 VLM 中的物理智能进行基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（Vision-Language Models, VLMs）已展现出强大的多模态推理能力，然而它们是否真正捕捉到现实世界动力学背后的物理一致性仍不明确。现有的基准测试范式往往存在评估碎片化的问题，聚焦于孤立的认知阶段，而忽视了感知、推理与物理判断之间固有的协同作用。缺乏整体视角限制了诊断 VLM 能否可靠地评估新兴生成模型物理真实性的能力。为解决这些问题，我们提出了 PhysVista，一个受人类“看-推理-评估”过程启发、通过闭环认知框架来评估 VLM 中物理智能的基准。PhysVista 通过联合评估物理状态感知、物理动力学推理和物理合理性评估来还原这一闭环。它进一步区分事件级推理与尺度级推理，从而实现对物理理解的细粒度分析。此外，PhysVista 同时纳入真实世界视频与 AI 生成视频，允许在多样领域和新兴生成场景中进行评估。在多种 VLM 上进行的大量实验揭示了其在物理推理与合理性评估方面存在显著局限，凸显出视觉识别与真正的物理理解之间持续存在的差距，并指向更具原则性的、以物理为基础的多模态智能设计方向。

title: Memorizon: Training World Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: Streaming world models should render a place consistently across repeated visits. Directly supervising such revisits requires training samples that capture both visits, often spanning minutes. Yet dense attention over the full span incurs quadratic costs, making long-span supervision expensive. Memorizon breaks this coupling: long spans are needed for supervision, but not for attention, since the two visits can share a forward pass without including every intervening frame. A training sample covers a span of any length but is scored only on its last $k$ chunks. Instead of tokenizing the history before them, each scored chunk retrieves its own top-$K$ latents by camera co-visibility, and the union of these requests forms a shared bank. The bank is bounded by $kK$, so the sequence stays bounded however long the span; at the shortest span the recipe is exactly conventional training. Adding the bank raises the cost of a step once; beyond that, a longer span costs little, and going from 100 to 400 s adds 12% to the step time. Against a sliding-window baseline, retrieval raises revisit consistency on every split, and a span long enough to reach the first visit of each return adds a further 24% to 30%, at some cost in image quality; beyond that span, more length no longer helps. Filling the bank from another episode lowers revisit correlation by 83%, so the model uses what it retrieves. Project page: https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

AI.title_zh: Memorizon：训练超越其上下文窗口的世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 流式世界模型应当在重复访问时一致地渲染同一地点。直接对这种重复访问进行监督，需要能同时涵盖两次访问的训练样本，而这两次访问往往跨越数分钟。然而，对完整跨度施加密集注意力会带来二次方代价，使得长跨度监督十分昂贵。Memorizon 打破了这种耦合：监督需要长跨度，但注意力并不需要，因为两次访问可以共享一次前向传播，而不必包含其间的每一帧。一个训练样本可覆盖任意长度的跨度，但只在最后 $k$ 个块（chunk）上被评分。评分块不再对其之前的历史进行分词（tokenize），而是各自按相机共可见性（camera co-visibility）检索自己的 top-$K$ 潜变量（latent），这些请求的并集构成一个共享库（bank）。该库的大小受 $kK$ 限制，因此无论跨度多长，序列长度都保持有界；在最短跨度下，该方案恰好就是常规训练。加入该库会使单步成本一次性增加；在此之后，更长的跨度成本增加很少，从 100 秒到 400 秒仅使单步时间增加 12%。与滑动窗口基线相比，检索在每一个划分上都提升了重访一致性，而长到足以覆盖每次返回中第一次访问的跨度又额外带来 24% 到 30% 的提升，代价是图像质量有所下降；超过该跨度后，更长的长度不再有帮助。用另一个片段来填充该库会使重访相关性降低 83%，说明模型确实利用了它所检索的内容。项目页面：https://tingtingliao.github.io/memorizon

title: Physis-Lang: Self-Evolving Language as a Physical Representation for Video World Model
summary: Video world models are expected to predict how the physical world evolves, yet they often produce visually plausible videos that violate basic physical principles. Existing approaches commonly assume that natural language is insufficient to represent the physical knowledge required for reliable generation, and therefore introduce additional visual, latent, numerical, or planning-based signals. We revisit this assumption and introduce Physis-Lang, a self-evolving framework that treats physical language as a shared and optimizable representation across data curation, model training, and video generation. Physis-Lang represents physical processes through language that describes their relevant entities, causes, interactions, governing principles, temporal evolution, and effects. To improve this representation, we construct PhysCapBench, which decomposes physical processes into atomic assertions and evaluates captions using recall and precision. An agentic loop iteratively analyzes assertion-level errors and refines the instruction used to produce physical captions. Physis-Lang further converts model deficiencies into textual descriptions and uses language-guided retrieval to identify visually diverse videos that cover missing physical processes. Experiments on four widely used physical video benchmarks with Wan and Cosmos backbones demonstrate consistent improvements in physical plausibility. Notably, starting from open-source Cosmos3-Nano backbones, our Physis-Lang-enhanced models surpass the leading proprietary Veo 3.1 model.

AI.title_zh: Physis-Lang：作为视频世界模型物理表示的自演化语言
AI.abstract_zh: 视频世界模型被期望能够预测物理世界如何演化，但它们常常生成视觉上看似合理却违反基本物理原理的视频。现有方法通常假设自然语言不足以表示可靠生成所需的物理知识，因此引入额外的视觉、潜变量、数值或基于规划的信号。我们重新审视这一假设，并提出 Physis-Lang，一个自演化框架，将物理语言视为贯穿数据整理、模型训练和视频生成的共享且可优化的表示。Physis-Lang 通过语言表示物理过程，描述其相关实体、原因、交互、支配原理、时间演化和效应。为改进这一表示，我们构建了 PhysCapBench，它将物理过程分解为原子断言，并使用召回率和精确率评估描述文本。一个智能体循环迭代地分析断言级别的错误，并优化用于生成物理描述文本的指令。Physis-Lang 进一步将模型缺陷转化为文本描述，并使用语言引导的检索来识别视觉上多样、覆盖缺失物理过程的视频。在四个广泛使用的物理视频基准上，使用 Wan 和 Cosmos 主干网络进行的实验表明，物理合理性得到了一致的提升。值得注意的是，从开源 Cosmos3-Nano 主干网络出发，我们经 Physis-Lang 增强的模型超越了领先的专有模型 Veo 3.1。

title: ViTeX-Bench: Benchmarking High-Fidelity Video Scene Text Editing
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 27 pages (10-page main text), 5 figures, 12 tables. Project page: https://vitex-bench.github.io/
summary: Recent video generation is increasingly realistic and controllable, yet video editing remains less developed, particularly for precise local edits that must preserve the original scene dynamics. Video scene text editing replaces text on scene surfaces, such as storefront signs, whiteboards, and product labels, while preserving the surrounding content, motion, and camera dynamics. Although scene text editing is well studied for images, video scene text editing that achieves high visual quality, temporal consistency, and edit locality remains underexplored. Existing resources offer limited paired real-video data, and general video-editing metrics do not directly measure whether the requested text remains correct over time. We introduce ViTeX-Bench, a benchmark suite comprising ViTeX-Dataset and a three-axis evaluation protocol. The dataset contains 387 real-world 720p videos with text-region masks and editing instructions: 230 provide reviewed, pipeline-generated paired edits for training, and 157 form a frozen evaluation split. The protocol evaluates text correctness, visual and temporal quality, and edit locality through 13 metrics, with one primary metric per axis and a Pareto comparison of their trade-offs. OCR calibration, human evaluation, and annotation-sensitivity analyses support the interpretation of these scores. Across eight baselines from four editing families, accurate text, temporal stability, and scene preservation remain difficult to achieve together. We also release ViTeX-Edit-14B, an open-source reference editor fine-tuned on the paired training split with motion-aligned glyph-video conditioning. It achieves CharAcc 0.688, the highest mean among the evaluated video-native editors, and the lowest comparable text-crop Warp among raw editor outputs. ViTeX-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for studying these trade-offs in video scene text editing.

AI.title_zh: ViTeX-Bench：面向高保真视频场景文本编辑的基准测试
AI.abstract_zh: 近期视频生成正变得日益逼真且可控，但视频编辑的发展仍相对滞后，尤其是那些必须保持原始场景动态的精确局部编辑。视频场景文本编辑旨在替换场景表面（如店面招牌、白板和产品标签）上的文本，同时保持周围内容、运动和镜头动态不变。尽管场景文本编辑在图像领域已有充分研究，但能够实现高视觉质量、时间一致性和编辑局部性的视频场景文本编辑仍探索不足。现有资源提供的配对真实视频数据有限，且通用视频编辑指标无法直接衡量所请求的文本是否随时间保持正确。我们提出 ViTeX-Bench，这是一个基准测试套件，包含 ViTeX-Dataset 与一套三轴评估协议。该数据集包含 387 个真实世界 720p 视频，并配有文本区域掩码和编辑指令：其中 230 个提供经审核的、由流水线生成的配对编辑用于训练，157 个构成冻结的评估划分。该协议通过 13 项指标评估文本正确性、视觉与时间质量以及编辑局部性，每个轴设有一项主指标，并对其权衡进行帕累托比较。OCR 校准、人工评估和标注敏感性分析为这些分数的解读提供支持。在来自四个编辑家族的八个基线方法中，准确的文本、时间稳定性和场景保持仍难以同时实现。我们还发布 ViTeX-Edit-14B，这是一个开源参考编辑器，在配对训练划分上以运动对齐的字形-视频条件进行微调。它取得 CharAcc 0.688，在被评估的视频原生编辑器中均值最高，并在原始编辑器输出中具有最低的可比文本裁剪 Warp。ViTeX-Bench 为研究视频场景文本编辑中的这些权衡提供了可复现的基础。

title: GLARE: Generating Listening Heads with Appropriate Reactions
comment: Accepted in NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://github.com/lzk901372/glare
summary: While talking head generation has advanced rapidly, generating natural listener behavior in dyadic conversations, which know when to react, how to react, and with what type of response, remains underexplored. Existing dyadic datasets lack fine-grained listener reaction annotations, and prevailing evaluation metrics inherited from talking-head and video generation measure visual realism rather than whether a listener reacted appropriately. We address these gaps along three aspects. First, we curate a listening-head-specific dataset built from RealTalk and Seamless Interaction, comprising approximately 147 hours of paired speaker-listener videos with 64,557 event-level reaction annotations across six categories: nodding, head shaking, smiling, laughing, frowning, and surprised. Second, we introduce an audio-driven baseline built on a flow-matching transformer, namely GLARE, with prosody conditioning derived from Qwen2-Audio and a temporal reaction loss that explicitly supervises frame-wise reactions. Third, we propose a reaction-oriented evaluation protocol that jointly measures reaction occurrence (R-F1), temporal alignment (R-tIoU), asymmetric temporal deviation (R-ATD), and reaction-region visual quality (R-FID), giving a more behaviorally grounded assessment than visual-quality-only metrics. Experiment results show consistent gains over prior listening-head methods in both visual fidelity and reaction-level metrics, suggesting that reaction-aware data, modeling, and evaluation are critical for natural listening behavior.

AI.title_zh: GLARE：生成具有恰当反应的倾听头部
AI.abstract_zh: 尽管说话头部生成已取得快速进展，但在双人对话中生成自然的倾听者行为——即知道何时反应、如何反应以及以何种类型的反应——仍然研究不足。现有的双人对话数据集缺乏细粒度的倾听者反应标注，而沿用自说话头部与视频生成的现有评估指标衡量的是视觉真实感，而非倾听者是否作出了恰当的反应。我们从三个方面弥补这些空白。第一，我们构建了一个专门针对倾听头部的数据集，基于 RealTalk 和 Seamless Interaction 构建，包含约 147 小时的成对说话者-倾听者视频，以及跨六个类别的 64,557 条事件级反应标注：点头、摇头、微笑、大笑、皱眉和惊讶。第二，我们提出了一种基于流匹配 transformer（flow-matching transformer）的音频驱动基线，即 GLARE，其韵律条件（prosody conditioning）来自 Qwen2-Audio，并采用显式监督逐帧反应的时间反应损失（temporal reaction loss）。第三，我们提出了一种面向反应的评估协议，联合衡量反应发生（R-F1）、时间对齐（R-tIoU）、非对称时间偏差（R-ATD）以及反应区域视觉质量（R-FID），从而给出比仅基于视觉质量的指标更具行为依据的评估。实验结果表明，在视觉保真度和反应级指标上，该方法相较此前的倾听头部方法均取得了一致提升，这表明反应感知的数据、建模与评估对于自然的倾听行为至关重要。

title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models
comment: 25 pages, 8 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://xiaji2021.github.io/LOCI/
summary: When a camera revisits a previously observed region, a video world model should reproduce what was there before. This requires both remembering past observations and retrieving the right one for the current viewpoint. Key-value caches preserve visual detail but grow with video length; recurrent memory is compact but compresses history into a fixed-size state, so individual past observations are no longer directly accessible. We introduce LOCI, a hybrid spatial-memory architecture that keeps both representations. In half of the transformer blocks, main attention keeps a key-value cache of past observations; in the other half, it is restricted to the current chunk and complemented by a recurrent linear-attention memory whose reads and writes are conditioned on projective camera geometry, so viewpoint enters both memory addressing and stored content. Recurrent readouts flow into subsequent cache-backed blocks and supply their queries with accumulated scene context. On the public MIND memory benchmark and on held-out recorded trajectories, LOCI reproduces revisited content more faithfully than representative world models and a same-recipe full-softmax model; with full history, it lowers peak memory at equal length by about 30% relative to full softmax. With a bounded bank of retained observations, it streams long videos at constant memory and remains more faithful than full softmax under the same budget.

AI.title_zh: LOCI：用于流式世界模型的空间线性记忆
AI.abstract_zh: 当相机重新访问先前观察过的区域时，视频世界模型应当重现此前那里的内容。这既需要记住过去的观测，也需要为当前视角检索出正确的那一次观测。键值缓存（key-value cache）能保留视觉细节，但会随视频长度增长；循环记忆（recurrent memory）紧凑，却将历史压缩进固定大小的状态，因此过去的单次观测不再可直接访问。我们提出 LOCI，一种混合空间记忆架构，同时保留这两种表示。在一半的 transformer 块中，主注意力（main attention）保留过去观测的键值缓存；在另一半中，它被限制在当前 chunk 内，并由一个循环线性注意力记忆（recurrent linear-attention memory）补充，其读取和写入以投影相机几何为条件，因此视角同时进入记忆的寻址与存储内容。循环读出流入后续由缓存支持的块，并为其查询提供累积的场景上下文。在公开的 MIND 记忆基准以及留存的录制轨迹上，LOCI 比代表性世界模型和同一配方的全 softmax 模型更忠实地重现重访内容；在完整历史下，与全 softmax 相比，它在等长度下将峰值内存降低约 30%。在使用有界保留观测库时，它以恒定内存流式处理长视频，并在相同预算下仍比全 softmax 更忠实。

title: Social-WM: Safety-Aware Latent World Models for Robot Social Navigation
summary: Safe social navigation requires a robot to anticipate not only the future consequences of its actions, but also whether a nominal action can actually be executed under surrounding physical and social constraints. We present Social-WM, an efficient latent world-model planning framework trained from egocentric RGB video sequences. Our key observation is that social-navigation experience contains a systematic discrepancy between the nominal action and the realizable action: a nominal forward action may be fully executed in free space, but needs to be constrained when heading towards a pedestrian or obstacle. Social-WM learns these safety-relevant consequences directly through action-conditioned future prediction, where the target is the actual observed future following each command. We further introduce a realizable inverse-dynamics objective that associates observed latent transitions with the action actually realized rather than the nominal one. At deployment, candidate actions are imagined through the latent world model, and the inverse dynamics model estimates their realizability; nominal--realizable discrepancy then provides a safety signal before execution. The learned dynamics and realizability model remain goal-independent and support both position- and image-goal navigation. On Social-HM3D, Social-WM achieves 63.77% success while reducing human collisions to 21.67%, and maintains strong performance under zero-shot transfer to Social-MP3D, without explicit pedestrian tracking, privileged human state, or online reinforcement learning.

AI.title_zh: Social-WM：面向机器人社会导航的安全感知潜在世界模型
AI.abstract_zh: 安全的社会导航要求机器人不仅能够预测其动作的未来后果，还要能够判断一个名义动作在周围的物理与社会约束下是否真的可以被执行。我们提出 Social-WM，一种高效、基于自我中心（egocentric）RGB 视频序列训练的潜在世界模型规划框架。我们的关键观察是：社会导航经验中包含名义动作与可实现动作之间的系统性差异——一个名义上前进的动作在自由空间中可以被完全执行，但当朝向行人或障碍物时则需要进行约束。Social-WM 通过以动作为条件的未来预测直接学习这些与安全相关的后果，其中预测目标是每条指令之后实际观测到的未来。我们进一步引入可实现逆动力学（realizable inverse-dynamics）目标，将观测到的潜在转移与实际实现的动作而非名义动作相关联。在部署阶段，候选动作通过潜在世界模型进行想象推演，逆动力学模型估计其可实现性；名义—可实现差异随后在执行前提供安全信号。所学习到的动力学与可实现性模型保持目标无关，并同时支持位置目标与图像目标导航。在 Social-HM3D 上，Social-WM 达到 63.77% 的成功率，同时将行人碰撞降低至 21.67%，并在零样本迁移到 Social-MP3D 时保持强劲性能，且无需显式的行人跟踪、特权人类状态或在线强化学习。

title: Dream4ACT: A Shared Visual Action Interface for Multi-Embodiment Video-Action Modeling
summary: Video generation models (VGMs) offer strong spatiotemporal priors for embodied observation--action modeling. However, joint-space action vectors lack explicit image-space structure and vary in dimensionality and semantics across embodiments, making it challenging to directly leverage the rich spatiotemporal priors of VGMs. End-effector visualizations provide an alternative but do not specify the full articulated configuration needed for robot execution. We present Dream4ACT, a world model built for joint video-action modeling across embodiments. To unify action representations across embodiments, we introduce a shared visual action interface, called action views, which render target joint configurations from four prescribed virtual cameras using URDF-based forward kinematics. This shared visual representation preserves embodiment-specific articulated geometry while allowing observation and action sequences to share a video autoencoder and diffusion transformer. Through masked flow-matching, our model supports forward dynamics, inverse dynamics, and joint observation--action generation within a single jointly trained model by varying which future sequences are corrupted. To recover executable action sequences from predicted action views, we propose a training-free, URDF-constrained multiview recovery mechanism, without a learned embodiment-specific decoder. Dream4ACT achieves an average success rate of 88.98\% on RoboTwin~2.0 and an overall score of 65.66 on TriWorldBench, supporting effective closed-loop manipulation and competitive action-conditioned multiview prediction through the visual action interface.

AI.title_zh: Dream4ACT：面向多具身视频-动作建模的共享视觉动作接口
AI.abstract_zh: 视频生成模型（VGMs）为具身观测—动作建模提供了强大的时空先验。然而，关节空间动作向量缺乏显式的图像空间结构，而且在不同具身之间其维度与语义各不相同，这使得直接利用 VGMs 丰富的时空先验颇具挑战。末端执行器可视化提供了一种替代方案，但无法指定机器人执行所需的完整关节构型。我们提出 Dream4ACT，一个为跨具身的联合视频-动作建模而构建的世界模型。为统一不同具身之间的动作表示，我们引入一种共享视觉动作接口，称为动作视图（action views），它使用基于 URDF 的正运动学，从四个预设虚拟相机渲染目标关节构型。这种共享视觉表示在保留具身特定关节几何的同时，使观测序列与动作序列能够共享同一个视频自编码器和扩散 Transformer。通过掩码流匹配（masked flow-matching），我们的模型通过改变哪些未来序列被破坏，在单一联合训练的模型中支持前向动力学、逆向动力学以及联合的观测—动作生成。为从预测的动作视图中恢复可执行的动作序列，我们提出一种无需训练、受 URDF 约束的多视图恢复机制，且不需要学习具身特定的解码器。Dream4ACT 在 RoboTwin~2.0 上取得 88.98\% 的平均成功率，在 TriWorldBench 上取得 65.66 的总分，通过该视觉动作接口支持有效的闭环操作以及具有竞争力的动作条件多视图预测。

title: VR-JEPA: Learning Contrastive-State Latent Guidance for Generation-based Video Reasoning
summary: Reasoning through video generation offers a promising path toward visual intelligence by modeling latent visual states and their dynamics. However, current video generation models often lack explicit guidance on how these states should evolve, leaving generated trajectories prone to physical and structural inconsistencies that undermine reasoning reliability. While the Video Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA) provides rich spatiotemporal priors learned through latent prediction, these general priors do not naturally adapt to the logical reasoning capabilities required for complex visual tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose VR-JEPA, a framework that aligns the V-JEPA predictor with task-specific reasoning logic through localized contrastive-state learning and uses its predicted latent trajectories to guide video generation for visual reasoning. Specifically, (i) we pair successful trajectories with generated alternatives under the same input conditions and use discrepancies in their V-JEPA representations to identify informative states and tokens for localized contrastive supervision. (ii) We further equip the V-JEPA predictor with skill-specific experts trained on anchor-task data, allowing the model to adaptively specialize its shared spatiotemporal priors across diverse cognitive domains. Together with skill-specific experts, this contrastive supervision enables VR-JEPA to predict latent trajectories that provide task-specific logical guidance for video generation. Comprehensive experiments on the large-scale VBVR-Pro-Bench dataset demonstrate that VR-JEPA achieves an $11.33\%$ relative improvement over the cutting-edge generation-based reasoning baseline, significantly mitigating physical artifacts and enhancing logical consistency.

AI.title_zh: VR-JEPA：为基于生成的视频推理学习对比状态潜在引导
AI.abstract_zh: 通过视频生成进行推理，为通向视觉智能提供了一条有前景的路径，其方式是建模潜在的视觉状态及其动态。然而，当前的视频生成模型往往缺乏关于这些状态应当如何演化的显式引导，使得生成的轨迹容易出现物理与结构上的不一致，从而削弱推理的可靠性。尽管视频联合嵌入预测架构（V-JEPA）提供了通过潜在预测学习到的丰富时空先验，但这些通用先验并不能自然地适应复杂视觉任务所需的逻辑推理能力。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 VR-JEPA，一个通过局部化对比状态学习使 V-JEPA 预测器与任务特定推理逻辑对齐，并利用其预测的潜在轨迹引导视频生成以进行视觉推理的框架。具体而言，(i) 我们在相同输入条件下将成功轨迹与生成的替代轨迹配对，并利用它们 V-JEPA 表示中的差异来识别具有信息量的状态与 token，以进行局部化对比监督。(ii) 我们进一步为 V-JEPA 预测器配备在锚任务数据上训练的特定技能专家，使模型能够自适应地将其共享时空先验在多样认知领域中专门化。结合特定技能专家，这种对比监督使 VR-JEPA 能够预测潜在轨迹，从而为视频生成提供任务特定的逻辑引导。在大规模 VBVR-Pro-Bench 数据集上的综合实验表明，VR-JEPA 相较于前沿的基于生成的推理基线取得了 $11.33\%$ 的相对提升，显著减轻了物理伪影并增强了逻辑一致性。

title: Enhancing Autoregressive Video Generation via Representation Adversarial Distillation
summary: Few-step autoregressive video generation enables efficient streaming synthesis, but errors introduced in early temporal blocks are reused as context and can propagate through subsequent rollouts, leading to detail degradation, structural drift, and unstable motion. Existing distribution matching distillation (DMD) primarily aligns student and teacher distributions in diffusion latent space, but provides no direct supervision over the perceptual quality of decoded videos. We introduce Radian, a representation-space adversarial distillation framework that complements on-policy DMD with real-data adversarial supervision in the feature space defined by a frozen visual foundation model (VFM). During training, Radian sparsely decodes frames from autoregressive student rollouts, extracts multi-level visual representations, and applies lightweight discriminator heads to distinguish generated outputs from real video frames. The DMD objective anchors the student to the pretrained teacher, while the representation-space adversarial objective supplies complementary perceptual and semantic gradients that promote high-quality modes. These additional components are discarded after training, leaving the generator architecture and inference-time denoising budget unchanged. Experiments on Wan2.1-1.3B cover four-step chunk-wise, one-step frame-wise, and minute-long autoregressive generation. Our method achieves a VBench Total of 0.8444 and a VideoAlign Total of 0.8033 under four-step generation, and improves VBench-Long from 0.7805 to 0.8041 over Rolling Forcing while using fewer denoising steps. Controlled comparisons across image, video, and diffusion representations further indicate that the choice of representation spaces induces distinct adversarial signals, and external VFM gradients complement DMD more effectively than adversarial supervision derived from diffusion-internal features.

AI.title_zh: 通过表征对抗蒸馏增强自回归视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 少步自回归视频生成能够实现高效的流式合成，但早期时间块中引入的误差会被当作上下文重复使用，并可能在随后的滚动生成中传播，导致细节退化、结构漂移和运动不稳定。现有的分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）主要在扩散潜空间中使学生分布与教师分布对齐，但并未对解码后视频的感知质量提供直接监督。我们提出 Radian，一种表征空间对抗蒸馏框架，它通过在冻结视觉基础模型（VFM）所定义的特征空间中进行真实数据对抗监督，对同策略 DMD 形成补充。在训练过程中，Radian 对自回归学生模型滚动生成中的帧进行稀疏解码，提取多层级视觉表征，并应用轻量判别器头来区分生成输出与真实视频帧。DMD 目标将学生模型锚定到预训练教师模型，而表征空间对抗目标则提供互补的感知与语义梯度，以促进高质量模态。这些附加组件在训练后被丢弃，生成器架构与推理时去噪预算保持不变。在 Wan2.1-1.3B 上的实验涵盖四步分块式生成、一步逐帧式生成以及分钟级自回归生成。在四步生成下，我们的方法取得 VBench Total 0.8444 和 VideoAlign Total 0.8033，并且在去噪步数更少的情况下，将 VBench-Long 从 Rolling Forcing 的 0.7805 提升至 0.8041。在图像、视频和扩散表征之间进行的受控比较进一步表明，表征空间的选择会诱导出不同的对抗信号，并且外部 VFM 梯度比源自扩散内部特征的对抗监督更有效地补充 DMD。

title: DashVMC: Real-Time Discrete World Model Control in Geometry Dash
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop "PTA: From Pretrained Representations to Acting Agents". Project page: https://tariolle.github.io/dash-vmc/
summary: World-model agents are usually evaluated in simulators that can wait for the policy; live games impose the opposite constraint, requiring capture, prediction, and action before the next frame. We present DashVMC, which learns a compact, action-conditioned world model from approximately two hours of recorded Geometry Dash gameplay. To test whether the learned dynamics are actionable, a controller is initialized by behavioural cloning (BC) and refined with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) entirely in frozen-model rollouts, without further interaction with the live game. Across three controller seeds, the refined policies survive longer than their BC initializations on all three official levels and a held-out community layout. At deployment, the baseline skips visual generation and sustains a 60-Hz capture-to-action loop on a consumer GPU. Action-conditioned continuations and rollout diagnostics show that the model remains useful for control despite imperfect long-horizon fidelity.

AI.title_zh: DashVMC：Geometry Dash 中的实时离散世界模型控制
AI.abstract_zh: 世界模型智能体通常在能够等待策略的模拟器中进行评估；而实时游戏施加了相反的约束，要求在下一帧到来之前完成采集、预测与动作。我们提出 DashVMC，它从约两小时录制的 Geometry Dash 游戏过程中学习一个紧凑的、以动作为条件的世界模型。为检验所学动力学是否可付诸行动，控制器先通过行为克隆（BC）初始化，并完全在冻结模型的 rollout 中用近端策略优化（PPO）进行精炼，无需与实时游戏进一步交互。在三个控制器随机种子下，精炼后的策略在全部三个官方关卡以及一个留出的社区布局上，存活时间均长于其 BC 初始化版本。在部署时，基线方法跳过视觉生成，并在消费级 GPU 上维持 60 Hz 的从采集到动作的循环。以动作为条件的延续与 rollout 诊断表明，尽管长期保真度并不完美，该模型对控制仍然有用。

title: Reconstructing the Dynamic World: A Representation-Centric View of 4D Scene Reconstruction
summary: 4D scene reconstruction aims to recover the evolving geometry, appearance, and motion of dynamic environments from visual observations. Despite substantial progress in neural scene representations, reconstructing dynamic scenes remains challenging due to non-rigid motion, occlusions, temporal inconsistencies, and the trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency. Recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have introduced diverse approaches to representing and reconstructing dynamic scenes, yet their relationships, underlying design choices, and evaluation protocols remain fragmented. In this paper, we present a unified perspective on 4D scene reconstruction, organizing existing methods around their scene representations, temporal modeling strategies, reconstruction pipelines, and optimization objectives. Through this framework, we examine how different design choices affect geometric fidelity, appearance consistency, motion representation, and computational efficiency. We further consolidate commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics, identify limitations in current experimental practices, and discuss open challenges in reconstructing complex, dynamic real-world environments. By connecting methodological developments with their underlying assumptions and evaluation evidence, this work provides a structured foundation for understanding existing approaches and identifying future research directions. An evolving collection of relevant papers and resources is available at https://github.com/ZiyangYan/Awesome-4D-Scene-Reconstruction.

AI.title_zh: 重建动态世界：以表示为视角的4D场景重建
AI.abstract_zh: 4D场景重建旨在从视觉观测中恢复动态环境不断演变的几何、外观与运动。尽管神经场景表示已取得重大进展，但由于非刚性运动、遮挡、时间不一致性以及重建保真度与计算效率之间的权衡，动态场景重建仍具挑战性。近期神经辐射场（Neural Radiance Fields, NeRF）与3D高斯溅射（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS）的进展为表示和重建动态场景引入了多种方法，但它们之间的关系、底层设计选择以及评估协议仍然较为分散。在本文中，我们提出关于4D场景重建的统一视角，围绕场景表示、时间建模策略、重建流程与优化目标来组织现有方法。通过这一框架，我们考察不同设计选择如何影响几何保真度、外观一致性、运动表示与计算效率。我们进一步整合了常用数据集与评估指标，指出当前实验实践中的局限，并讨论重建复杂、动态真实世界环境中的开放挑战。通过将方法学发展与其底层假设及评估证据相联系，本工作为理解现有方法并识别未来研究方向提供了结构化基础。相关论文与资源的持续更新集合见 https://github.com/ZiyangYan/Awesome-4D-Scene-Reconstruction。

title: Beyond Policy Alignment: Closing the Planning-Learning Loop for Robot Control with Learned World Models
summary: Planning with learned world models combines online trajectory optimization with learned value and policy functions for high-dimensional control. Because the planner determines the experience used for learning, while the learned critic and actor in turn score and propose future plans, planning and learning form a closed feedback loop. TD-MPC is a prominent instance of this design. Recent policy-constrained variants strengthen one part of the loop by aligning the learned policy with planner behavior. We introduce PL-MPC (Planning-Learning MPC), which additionally modifies critic supervision and planner terminal-value estimation. Hybrid multi-step TD targets expose critic updates to more realized rewards before bootstrapping; disagreement-aware terminal estimates reduce the influence of uncertain critic values during MPPI planning; and return-weighted actor distillation emphasizes planner-executed actions from high-return episodes. The world-model architecture and MPPI optimizer are otherwise unchanged. On HumanoidBench, the largest gains occur on \texttt{balance-hard}, where Total Average Return (TAR) increases from $98\pm18$ to $387\pm255$, and \texttt{hurdle}, from $199\pm13$ to $466\pm200$; performance across the broader benchmark remains task dependent, and PL-MPC remains competitive on DMControl. Controlled ablations show different component interactions across the two tasks. We further demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on wrench-nut alignment with a 7-DoF KUKA IIWA14, obtaining higher observed success than TD-M(PC)^2 on the training object size and two unseen sizes. Code and data will be available at: https://pl-mpc-humanoid.github.io.

AI.title_zh: 超越策略对齐：为机器人控制闭合学习世界模型中的规划-学习回路
AI.abstract_zh: 基于学习到的世界模型进行规划，将在线轨迹优化与学习得到的价值函数和策略函数相结合，用于高维控制。由于规划器决定了用于学习的经验，而学习得到的评论家（critic）与演员（actor）反过来又为未来规划打分并提出方案，规划与学习构成了一个闭合的反馈回路。TD-MPC 是这一设计的一个典型实例。近期的策略约束变体通过将学习到的策略与规划器行为对齐，强化了该回路的一部分。我们提出 PL-MPC（Planning-Learning MPC），它进一步修改了评论家监督与规划器终值估计。混合多步 TD 目标在自举（bootstrapping）之前使评论家更新接触到更多已实现奖励；分歧感知的终值估计降低了 MPPI 规划过程中不确定评论家值的影响；回报加权演员蒸馏则强调来自高回报回合中由规划器执行的动作。除此之外，世界模型架构与 MPPI 优化器保持不变。在 HumanoidBench 上，最大的提升出现在 \texttt{balance-hard} 上，总平均回报（Total Average Return, TAR）从 $98\pm18$ 增加到 $387\pm255$，以及 \texttt{hurdle} 上，从 $199\pm13$ 增加到 $466\pm200$；在更广泛基准上的表现仍依赖于具体任务，且 PL-MPC 在 DMControl 上仍具有竞争力。受控消融实验显示，两个任务上的组件交互有所不同。我们进一步展示了在 7 自由度 KUKA IIWA14 上进行扳手-螺母对齐的零样本仿真到现实迁移，在训练物体尺寸和两个未见尺寸上均获得了高于 TD-M(PC)^2 的观测成功率。代码与数据将发布于：https://pl-mpc-humanoid.github.io。

title: OverForge: Reasoning Through Strategies and Tactics Helps Cooperative Lifelong Adaptation
summary: Cooperative language-model agents must coordinate over long horizons and adapt to changing environments and to partners with unfamiliar conventions, yet existing agents map observations to actions without separating persistent coordination strategies from their tactical execution. We introduce OverForge, a training-free hierarchical architecture that separates strategic reasoning over roles and divisions of labour from tactical reasoning over actions within each agent's private, partner-conditioned world model. A metacognitive Prefrontal Cortex Module couples the two levels by forming strategy-action branches, imagining their consequences with a forward model, and committing when confident. In OvercookedV2, OverForge delivers 7 soups in a connected kitchen versus 3 for each flat LLM baseline, retains agreed roles, and adopts roles proposed by unfamiliar partners. Ablations and a fixed-strategy probe show that persistent strategies guide tactical adaptation while each reasoning level contributes to coordination. Memory restarts show that cross-episode partner knowledge supports task performance and partner prediction, linking the hierarchy to continual adaptation.

AI.title_zh: OverForge：通过策略与战术的推理助力合作式终身适应
AI.abstract_zh: 合作式语言模型智能体必须在长时程上协调，并适应不断变化的环境以及具有陌生约定的伙伴，然而现有智能体将观察映射为动作，并未将持久的协调策略与其战术执行相分离。我们提出OverForge，一种免训练的分层架构，它将关于角色与分工的战略推理，与在每个智能体私有的、以伙伴为条件的世界模型内关于动作的战术推理分离开来。一个元认知前额叶皮层模块（Prefrontal Cortex Module）通过形成策略-动作分支、用前向模型想象其后果，并在有信心时进行提交，将这两个层级耦合起来。在OvercookedV2中，OverForge在连通的厨房中交付7碗汤，而每个扁平LLM基线为3碗；它保持已商定的角色，并采纳陌生伙伴提出的角色。消融实验与固定策略探测表明，持久策略引导战术适应，同时每个推理层级都对协调有所贡献。记忆重启实验表明，跨回合的伙伴知识支持任务表现与伙伴预测，从而将这一分层结构与持续适应联系起来。

title: RoboCoach: World Models as Active Coaches for Compositional Robot Skills
summary: Long-horizon robot manipulation reuses skills across many task compositions, but improving these compositions with additional end-to-end demonstrations is costly. A practical self-improving system must decide both what to teach next and where to apply that supervision. We present ROBOCOACH, a world-model-guided coaching framework that uses imagined failures to guide demonstration requests and expert updates. Its Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve (RIDI) loop executes reusable skill experts inside COACHWORLD, our shared action-conditioned world model, and uses a progress judge to record the first subtask that fails to complete. Aggregated records select which subtask demonstrations to acquire and which expert adapters to update. Across two simulation suites and two real-robot platforms, imagined and deployed success correlate over 22 task-policy pairs (rho = 0.840). Controlled comparisons show that our coaching method outperforms matched baselines under matched data budgets and update schedules. With only 150 additional subtask demonstrations, success rises from 13.3% to 75.0% on Franka and from 40.0% to 83.8% on AgileX. The coached experts also transfer to four held-out compositions, achieving an average success of 35.0%, compared with 0% for a shared-policy baseline updated with uniformly acquired demonstrations. Together, these results show that world models can serve as active coaches, turning imagined failures into targeted supervision for modular policy improvement. Project Page: https://robocoach-ai.github.io/

AI.title_zh: RoboCoach：将世界模型作为组合式机器人技能的主动教练
AI.abstract_zh: 长时程机器人操作会在许多任务组合中复用技能，但通过额外的端到端演示来改进这些组合代价高昂。一个实用的自我改进系统必须同时决定接下来教什么以及在何处施加该监督。我们提出 ROBOCOACH，一个由世界模型引导的教练框架，它利用想象出的失败来指导演示请求与专家更新。其 Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve（RIDI，即路由—想象—诊断—改进）循环在我们的共享动作条件世界模型 COACHWORLD 中执行可复用的技能专家，并使用进度评判器记录第一个未能完成的子任务。聚合后的记录用于选择获取哪些子任务演示以及更新哪些专家适配器。在两个仿真套件和两个真实机器人平台上，想象成功率与部署成功率在 22 个任务—策略对上相关（rho = 0.840）。受控比较表明，在匹配的数据预算和更新计划下，我们的教练方法优于相匹配的基线。仅用 150 个额外子任务演示，Franka 上的成功率从 13.3% 提升到 75.0%，AgileX 上从 40.0% 提升到 83.8%。经教练的专家还能迁移到四个留出组合，平均成功率达到 35.0%，而用均匀获取的演示更新的共享策略基线为 0%。这些结果共同表明，世界模型可以作为主动教练，将想象出的失败转化为有针对性的监督，以实现模块化策略改进。项目页面：https://robocoach-ai.github.io/

title: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
summary: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. Using these annotations, we train ChronoGraphVLM by adapting pretrained VLMs in two stages. Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning teaches the models to reconstruct observed transitions and predict future ones as graph traces before answering. Subsequent joint 4D graph reinforcement learning directly rewards graph properties and answer correctness. Experiments across model scales show improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines and zero-shot transfer to VLM4D. Real-world demonstrations further show that graph-based planning and affordance grounding support mobile manipulation through existing robot skills without additional fine-tuning.

AI.title_zh: ChronoGraph：面向交互理解与具身规划的、基于视觉语言模型的功能性4D场景图
AI.abstract_zh: 具身智能体必须确定在哪里行动，预期由此产生的场景变化，并解释观察到的结果以指导后续动作。这要求将4D交互理解（解释过去的动作如何改变了场景）与空间具身规划（确定如何以及在哪里朝目标行动，并预期由此产生的场景变化）联系起来。我们提出ChronoGraph，一种功能性4D场景图，它将作用于可供性部件（affordance parts）上的动作与语义及几何状态变化联系起来。通过以相同形式表示观察到的和预期的状态转移，它为理解与规划提供了共同的基础。我们通过一个自动数据引擎构建了ChronoGraphBench，该引擎将人类交互视频和模拟机器人轨迹转换为图标注问题，用于在这两项任务上训练和评估视觉语言模型（VLMs）。利用这些标注，我们通过两个阶段对预训练VLM进行适配，训练出ChronoGraphVLM。图作为思维链（Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought）监督微调教导模型在回答之前以图轨迹的形式重建观察到的状态转移并预测未来的状态转移。随后的联合4D图强化学习直接对图属性和答案正确性给予奖励。跨模型规模的实验显示，相较于相应的预训练基线有所提升，并实现了向VLM4D的零样本迁移。真实世界演示进一步表明，基于图的规划和可供性定位（affordance grounding）可借助现有机器人技能支持移动操作，而无需额外微调。

title: Why Do Conventional World Models Fail to Learn Cellular Automata?
comment: 35 pages, 18 figures. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/guoshaoyang-pku/momentum-induction
summary: Although conventional world models - auto-regressive or diffusion models based on transformers or convolutional networks - may learn surface statistics of world dynamics, can they learn the exact world dynamics from its observed history? Leveraging cellular automata as a simple testbed, we find the answer to be no in many cases. Conventional architectures predict most pixels correctly yet rarely complete a rollout: a CNN predicts 96.3% of cells but completes 18.9% of rollouts; a joint diffusion model completes none. We trace the gap to three failure modes of these world models - namely, they fail to exactly capture spatial locality, temporal locality or temporal stability. Simple changes repair each: (1) for spatial locality, two-dimensional rotary positions lift a transformer from 39.1% to 100% on the Game of Life; (2) for temporal locality, handing each token its cell's previous-frame neighbourhood lifts the same transformer from 25.8% to 99.9% on unseen rules; (3) for temporal stability, causal freezing lifts the same diffusion weights from 42.2% to 99.9%. None of the three changes touches the architectural backbone; each only modifies the information flow within it. We also compare joint and ordered sampling on billiards and, in an exploratory study, on a simulated Burgers equation.

AI.title_zh: 为什么传统世界模型无法学习元胞自动机？
AI.abstract_zh: 尽管传统世界模型——基于 transformer 或卷积网络的自回归模型或扩散模型——可能学到世界动态的表层统计规律，但它们能否从观测到的历史中学习到精确的世界动态？以元胞自动机作为简单的测试平台，我们发现在许多情况下答案是否定的。传统架构能正确预测大多数像素，却很少能完成一次 rollout：CNN 能预测 96.3% 的细胞，但只能完成 18.9% 的 rollout；联合扩散模型完成率为零。我们将这一差距追溯到这类世界模型的三种失效模式——即它们无法精确捕捉空间局部性、时间局部性或时间稳定性。简单的改动即可修复每一种失效：(1) 对于空间局部性，二维旋转位置编码（two-dimensional rotary positions）使一个 transformer 在 Game of Life 上从 39.1% 提升到 100%；(2) 对于时间局部性，将每个 token 所在细胞在上一帧的邻域交给该 token，使同一 transformer 在未见规则上从 25.8% 提升到 99.9%；(3) 对于时间稳定性，因果冻结（causal freezing）使同一扩散模型的权重从 42.2% 提升到 99.9%。这三项改动均未触及架构主干；每一项只修改主干内部的信息流动。我们还在台球（billiards）上比较了联合采样与有序采样，并在模拟 Burgers 方程上开展了一项探索性研究。

title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
comment: 64 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://groundingpi.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundingPI Model: https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundingPI
summary: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.

AI.title_zh: GroundingPI：一个面向物理智能的、以视觉基元进行定位的基础模型
AI.abstract_zh: 精确定位至关重要。它要指明哪个物体是目标以及该物体在哪里，即使在杂乱场景中以及对于微小物体也是如此，而且它必须足够快以支持闭环控制。然而，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界-动作模型（WAMs）从通用视觉-语言和视频生成骨干网络中获取感知能力，而这些骨干网络在这些情境下仍然失败。我们提出 GroundingPI，一个 4B 的定位基础模型，它将点和框生成为共享词表中的量化坐标。训练结合了多模态与空间预训练、监督微调，以及使用 GRPO 的强化学习，并使用来自公开数据集和专用数据引擎的监督。在横跨 11 种感知能力的 34 个定位基准上，面对 44 个基线，GroundingPI 确立了新的最先进水平，平均达到 73.68%，高于规模更大的 GPT-6 Astra（71.54%）。作为下游视觉骨干网络，GroundingPI 提升了机器人操作和自动驾驶的性能。在 RoboTwin 2.0 上，它在全部四种分布外设置中优于我们评估的每一个主流骨干网络，相对最强骨干网络最高提升 24.8%。在 RoboCasa-GR1 上，用 50% 的演示训练的 GroundingPI 优于用 75% 演示训练的那些基线。在 nuScenes 上，作为视觉骨干网络使用时，GroundingPI 达到 0.296 m 的平均开环 L2 误差。我们系统地分析了 GroundingPI 预训练的规模和数据组成。随着预训练规模扩大，下游的自动驾驶和机器人操作得到改善。在这 11 种感知能力上分析数据配方表明，密集定位对二者都有显著益处，而 OCR 具有作为感知学习催化剂的潜力。这些结果支持将定位作为感知基础，并支持将专门的感知预训练作为物理智能基础模型的一个有前景的方向。

title: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
comment: 61 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: https://groundingpi.github.io/groundanything/ Code: [https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundAnything](https://github.com/groundingpi/GroundAnything) Model: https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundAnything, https://huggingface.co/GroundingPI/GroundAnything-VLM
summary: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. Across 30 grounding benchmarks, our autoregressive variant, GroundAnything-VLM, establishes a new overall state of the art among similarly sized models at 72.42%, remaining competitive with GPT-6 Astra (71.35%). With entropy-guided decoding, GroundAnything also surpasses the prior state of the art at this scale, averaging 61.75% versus 53.32% for the fast MTP-based LocateAnything model. We further explore decoding strategies, showing that an optional self-speculative mode achieves a $4.51\times$ speedup over the AR counterpart with a 0.74 percentage-point drop in COCO F1mIoU. Infrastructure experiments show that progressive inference optimizations translate parallel decoding into practical speedups. These support efficient visual grounding in latency-sensitive real-world systems.

AI.title_zh: GroundAnything：以 Flash 速度协调并行解码与精确视觉定位
AI.abstract_zh: 自回归（AR）定位模型将空间预测序列化，从而引入顺序延迟，并对输出 token 施加因果顺序。我们将定位视为视觉证据提取：对象、位置与空间关系由图像和查询共同约束，但它们之间的依赖关系并不意味着存在内在的从左到右的生成顺序。这一区别使双向扩散成为自然的适配方案，允许空间假设并行产生，并通过迭代去噪共同细化。我们提出 GroundAnything，一个 4B 参数的定位基础模型，通过分块去噪协调快速并行解码与精确定位。训练结合了来自公开数据集和专用数据引擎的定位预训练、以联合 AR 与扩散目标进行的直接 AR 到扩散转换、监督微调，以及基于 GRPO 的强化学习后训练。在 30 个定位基准上，我们的自回归变体 GroundAnything-VLM 以 72.42% 在同类规模模型中建立了新的整体最优水平，并与 GPT-6 Astra（71.35%）保持竞争力。借助熵引导解码，GroundAnything 在该规模上也超越了此前的最优水平，平均达到 61.75%，而基于 MTP 的快速模型 LocateAnything 为 53.32%。我们进一步探索了解码策略，表明可选的自推测模式相较 AR 对应模型实现了 $4.51\times$ 加速，同时在 COCO F1mIoU 上仅下降 0.74 个百分点。基础设施实验表明，渐进式推理优化可将并行解码转化为实际加速。这些结果为延迟敏感的真实世界系统中的高效视觉定位提供了支持。

title: SPOON: Towards Coherent Compositional 3D Scene Generation from Uncalibrated Multi-view Images
summary: Compositional 3D scene generation aims to recover complete 3D object shapes and their spatial arrangement from visual observations. Recent image-conditioned 3D generators provide strong priors for producing high-quality object geometry, making the generation of complex scenes increasingly practical. A central challenge is therefore to spatially organize these generated assets into a globally coherent scene while remaining consistent with multi-view observations. Existing approaches either entangle scene layout with object generation or separately estimate spatial placement from view-specific observations, where pose hypotheses may remain ambiguous and inconsistent across views, often resulting in an incoherent object-camera soup. We introduce SPOON, a framework that reformulates multi-view compositional 3D generation as scene-level, geometry-grounded pose reasoning. Rather than treating view-specific object pose hypotheses independently, SPOON coordinates them using reconstruction-derived multi-view geometry through a Guide-Route-Reconcile paradigm. This progressively organizes object poses and camera configurations into a coherent scene-level spatial arrangement. Extensive experiments on ARSG-110K and MIDI-3D-Front demonstrate consistent improvements in object placement and scene composition across varying numbers of input views. On ARSG-110K, SPOON reduces scene-level and object-level Chamfer distances by 12.7% and 17.7%, respectively, compared with a strong baseline.

AI.title_zh: SPOON：面向由未标定多视图图像生成连贯组合式三维场景
AI.abstract_zh: 组合式三维场景生成旨在从视觉观测中恢复完整的三维物体形状及其空间布局。近年来，基于图像条件的三维生成器为生成高质量物体几何提供了强有力的先验，使复杂场景的生成日益切实可行。因此，一个核心挑战在于如何在空间上将这些生成的资产组织成一个全局连贯的场景，同时保持与多视图观测的一致性。现有方法要么将场景布局与物体生成纠缠在一起，要么从各视图特定的观测中分别估计空间放置，而其中的位姿假设可能仍然存在歧义，且在不同视图之间不一致，往往导致不连贯的物体—相机混杂体。我们提出了 SPOON，这一框架将多视图组合式三维生成重新表述为场景级、以几何为依据的位姿推理。SPOON 不再独立地处理各视图特定的物体位姿假设，而是通过 Guide-Route-Reconcile 范式，利用重建得到多视图几何来协调这些假设。这一过程逐步将物体位姿与相机配置组织为连贯的场景级空间布局。在 ARSG-110K 与 MIDI-3D-Front 上的大量实验表明，在不同数量的输入视图下，物体放置与场景组合均取得了一致的改进。在 ARSG-110K 上，与一个强基线相比，SPOON 将场景级和物体级的 Chamfer 距离分别降低了 12.7% 和 17.7%。

title: KilometerVision: A New Frontier for Large-Scale Spatial Intelligence in VLMs
summary: We push the frontier of large-scale spatial intelligence in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and introduce the first benchmark that probes geographical layout understanding from real-world videos, spanning up to 1km distances. Inspired by the cognitive science literature, we evaluate models against the hierarchical stages of human spatial awareness: anchoring via landmarks, connecting them through routes, and integrating these into global mental maps. Extensive experiments reveal a fundamental divergence in how current AI models process spatial information. Instead of utilising true path integration or forming geometric survey knowledge, we find that VLMs rely almost entirely on 2D visual recognition and text-matching to bypass complex spatial reasoning. The benchmark is publicly available at https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/kilometervision.html.

AI.title_zh: KilometerVision：VLM 中大规模空间智能的新前沿
AI.abstract_zh: 我们推进了视觉语言模型（VLM）中大规模空间智能的前沿，并提出了首个从真实世界视频中探究地理布局理解的基准，其覆盖距离最远可达 1km。受认知科学文献启发，我们依据人类空间感知的层级阶段来评估模型：通过地标进行锚定、通过路线将它们连接起来，以及将这些整合为全局心理地图。大量实验揭示了当前 AI 模型处理空间信息方式上的根本性分歧。我们发现，VLM 几乎完全依赖 2D 视觉识别和文本匹配来绕过复杂的空间推理，而非利用真正的路径整合或形成几何测量知识。该基准已公开提供，网址为 https://perception-test-challenge.github.io/kilometervision.html。

title: Lens Flare Removal and Reconstruction
summary: The presence of lens flares in images can significantly reduce the quality of downstream application results for tasks such as 3D scene reconstruction. This is because lens flares are a property of the camera imaging system, and not a part of the underlying scene being modeled. There are previous methods that tackle the removal of small flares focused around a light source. However, existing methods struggle with large flares, such as those that fill the entire image. In this work, we compile a novel dataset for large-flare removal, combining publicly available real-world data with a procedural generation pipeline. We fine-tune a diffusion-based model on our dataset to remove complex, large lens flares. On the other hand, lens flares remain effective artistic tools, widely used in the media. While there are ways to simulate 2D flares, representing and reconstructing lens flares consistently across multiple views has not yet been explored. To achieve this, we introduce a flare representation model that leverages the symmetry of lens flares about the camera's principal point. We propose a computational pipeline to jointly optimize this flare model and a Gaussian splatting model (3DGS). This enables the decomposition of a 3D scene into lens flares and the scene itself, using our flare-removal model. Because the reconstructed flare is explicit and re-renderable, it can be edited and transferred to novel images and new 3D scenes. We evaluate removal on an established benchmark and a new one for large reflective flares, quantify the flare/scene decomposition directly, and show that the pipeline is robust to errors in automatic light-source localization.

AI.title_zh: 镜头光晕的去除与重建
AI.abstract_zh: 图像中镜头光晕（lens flare）的存在会显著降低诸如三维场景重建等下游应用结果的质量。这是因为镜头光晕是相机成像系统的一种属性，而不是所建模的底层场景的一部分。以往已有一些方法致力于去除围绕光源的小型光晕。然而，现有方法难以处理大型光晕，例如那些充满整幅图像的光晕。在本工作中，我们构建了一个用于大型光晕去除的新数据集，将公开可得的真实世界数据与程序化生成流程相结合。我们在该数据集上微调了一个基于扩散的模型，以去除复杂的大型镜头光晕。另一方面，镜头光晕仍然是一种有效的艺术工具，在媒体中被广泛使用。尽管已有模拟二维光晕的方法，但在多个视角之间一致地表示和重建镜头光晕尚未被探索。为实现这一点，我们引入了一个光晕表示模型，该模型利用镜头光晕关于相机主点的对称性。我们提出了一种计算流程，以联合优化该光晕模型与高斯泼溅模型（3DGS）。借助我们的光晕去除模型，这能够将三维场景分解为镜头光晕与场景本身。由于重建出的光晕是显式的且可重新渲染的，它可以被编辑并迁移到新的图像和新的三维场景中。我们在一个已有基准以及一个针对大型反射性光晕的新基准上评估了去除效果，直接量化了光晕/场景的分解，并表明该流程对自动光源定位中的误差具有鲁棒性。

title: PartiCam: Camera Controlled Video Generation with Reward Guidance
summary: We present PartiCam, a training-free Particle filtering rooted method for improved Camera controlled video generation. Generating videos that follow a precisely specified camera trajectory remains challenging for large video diffusion models. Training-free approaches are backbone-agnostic and avoid the need to construct large camera-annotated datasets by steering pretrained models toward the desired camera motion at test time. This enables the generation of camera-controlled video data that can subsequently be used to train camera-conditioned video diffusion models. Existing sampling-based guidance approaches often suffer from unstable trajectories: they either explore too broadly and fail to respect the target camera motion or collapse early and lose visual diversity over time. We introduce a global-local refinement framework for diffusion reward guidance, enabling accurate and consistent camera control during video generation. Our method builds on Sequential Monte-Carlo (SMC) guidance, but introduces a local refinement stage based on particle filtered resampling. Experiments show large improvements in camera trajectory adherence, reduced drift, and better visual quality, without requiring model retraining.

AI.title_zh: PartiCam：基于奖励引导的相机控制视频生成
AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出 PartiCam，一种无需训练的、以粒子滤波为基础的方法，用于改进相机控制的视频生成。生成遵循精确指定相机轨迹的视频，对于大型视频扩散模型而言仍具挑战性。免训练方法不依赖特定主干网络（backbone-agnostic），并避免了构建大规模相机标注数据集的需要，其做法是在测试时将预训练模型引导向所需的相机运动。这使得能够生成相机控制的视频数据，而这些数据随后可用于训练以相机为条件的视频扩散模型。现有的基于采样的引导方法常常出现不稳定的轨迹：它们要么探索范围过广而无法遵循目标相机运动，要么过早坍缩并随时间推移失去视觉多样性。我们提出一种用于扩散奖励引导的全局-局部细化框架，从而在视频生成过程中实现准确且一致的相机控制。我们的方法建立在序贯蒙特卡洛（Sequential Monte-Carlo, SMC）引导之上，但引入了一个基于粒子滤波重采样的局部细化阶段。实验表明，在无需重新训练模型的情况下，相机轨迹遵循度大幅提升、漂移减少、视觉质量更好。

title: Mutual Equilibrium: Multimodal Representation Learning through Reciprocal Feedback
summary: This work proposes a mutual feedback architecture, MEQ, that refines the two inputs, of possibly different modalities, into a pair of coupled embeddings such that each embedding reflects the information of the other. The core idea is to incorporate continuous interchange of information between the two inputs. This idea leads to a mutual feedback architecture consisting of two components whose outputs are fed back into the other. The final output of this model is defined as the fixed point of this interaction. We provide theoretical analysis that offers interpretation of this model as well as design choices to prevent failure cases. We show the benefits of MEQ through classification and visual grounding tasks spanning various datasets. Quantitatively, our model outperforms or shows competitive performance on concatenation-based multimodal classification problems. Qualitatively, the proposed interactive mechanism allows the model to progressively refine the visual grounding when paired with complementary modality, thus demonstrating the power of mutual feedback under such settings.

AI.title_zh: 相互均衡：通过互惠反馈的多模态表示学习
AI.abstract_zh: 本工作提出了一种互反馈架构 MEQ，它将两个可能属于不同模态的输入细化为一对耦合嵌入（coupled embeddings），使得每个嵌入都反映另一个嵌入的信息。其核心思想是在两个输入之间引入信息的连续交换。这一思想引出了一种互反馈架构，该架构由两个组件构成，二者的输出被反馈回对方。该模型的最终输出被定义为这种交互的不动点（fixed point）。我们提供了理论分析，既给出了对该模型的解释，也给出了用以防止失败情况的设计选择。我们通过跨越多个数据集的分类和视觉定位（visual grounding）任务展示了 MEQ 的优势。在定量上，我们的模型在基于拼接（concatenation-based）的多模态分类问题上表现优于或具有竞争力的性能。在定性上，所提出的交互机制使模型在与互补模态配对时能够逐步细化视觉定位，从而证明了互反馈在此类设定下的能力。

title: UniWAM Technical Report: Unified Mobile Manipulation via Mixed-Stream World-Action Modeling and Manipulation Anchor Pose Supervision
summary: Mobile manipulation requires precise navigation to a manipulation-ready pose followed by reliable object interaction. These two stages differ in action spaces and visual requirements, which complicates unified policy learning. In addition, collecting diverse real-world navigation data with explicit manipulation-ready pose supervision remains costly and difficult to scale. We introduce UniWAM, a unified mixed-stream world-action model with separate action encoders and output heads for navigation and manipulation, sharing a common backbone. This design supports joint representation learning on independently sampled navigation and manipulation data. UniWAM supports independent inference for either stream and batch-parallel inference for both. We further introduce Manipulation Anchor Pose (MAP) supervision for where to stop and how to orient for manipulation. An automated pipeline constructs MAP-Data from large-scale 3D scenes, yielding over 1.5 million episodes and 7,500 hours. MAP-Data provides per-frame target-object bounding boxes and image-plane MAP coordinates as auxiliary navigation supervision. Together with projected end-effector trajectories for manipulation, these prediction targets provide stream-specific image-plane supervision for action learning from egocentric observations. With large-scale MAP-Data, UniWAM outperforms the strongest external baselines on our MAP-Bench by 30.1\% in position error and 44.0\% in heading error. Across 24 real-robot tasks, UniWAM achieves leading results in MAP navigation and mobile manipulation, with competitive manipulation performance. We have released code, data, and benchmark.

AI.title_zh: UniWAM 技术报告：通过混合流世界-动作建模与操作锚点位姿监督实现统一移动操作
AI.abstract_zh: 移动操作需要精确导航到可操作的位姿，随后进行可靠的物体交互。这两个阶段在动作空间和视觉需求上有所不同，这使得统一的策略学习变得复杂。此外，采集带有显式可操作位姿监督的多样化真实世界导航数据仍然成本高昂且难以扩展。我们提出 UniWAM，一种统一的混合流世界-动作模型，为导航和操作分别设置独立的动作编码器和输出头，并共享一个共同主干。该设计支持在独立采样的导航与操作数据上进行联合表征学习。UniWAM 支持任一分支的独立推理，以及两个分支的批并行推理。我们进一步提出操作锚点位姿（Manipulation Anchor Pose, MAP）监督，用于确定在何处停止以及如何调整朝向以进行操作。一条自动化流水线从大规模 3D 场景构建 MAP-Data，产出超过 150 万条回合和 7,500 小时的数据。MAP-Data 提供逐帧的目标物体边界框和图像平面 MAP 坐标，作为辅助导航监督。结合用于操作的投影末端执行器轨迹，这些预测目标为从第一人称视角观测中进行动作学习提供了分支特定的图像平面监督。借助大规模 MAP-Data，UniWAM 在我们的 MAP-Bench 上相较最强的外部基线，位置误差降低 30.1\%，朝向误差降低 44.0\%。在 24 项真实机器人任务中，UniWAM 在 MAP 导航和移动操作方面取得领先结果，并具有有竞争力的操作性能。我们已发布代码、数据和基准。

title: TexTailor: Texture-Preserving Video Virtual Try-On via Adaptive Garment Conditioning
